column1: # The golden audio and video clips (plan 5, spec Fixtures: Audio 12 clips, Video 12 clips), written by hand. Read by `kit-fixtures.sh build golden-av`
# (fixtures/golden-av/{audio,video,damaged}) beside fixtures/answers.csv, which stays the only place that says where a sentence starts.
# Tab separated, one line a fact; a line that starts with # is a comment.
#   aclip    <path under golden-av> <seconds>                         an audio clip of that length (the extension picks the codec)
#   vclip    <path> <seconds> <audio: none|speech|silent>             a video clip; none: no audio track; speech: the clip's say lines are its
#                                                                    soundtrack; silent: an audio track of digital silence
#   say      <path> <start s> <gain> <text>                           one line spoken by `say` (voice Samantha) from that second
#   sentence <path> <gain>                                            the sentence of the key row of this file (the `note`), spoken from the
#                                                                    row's `locator`, so the key and the file cannot drift
#   filler   <path> <from s> <to s> <gains, comma separated>          neutral counting spoken every 5 s from <from> to <to>; the gain of the
#                                                                    slot at second t is gains[(t / 5) mod count] and its words phrase[(t / 5) mod 6]
#                                                                    one scene of a video clip, drawn like the golden photos (objects as in
#                                                                    golden-photos.tsv: glyph:cx,cy,size;...); the shots of a clip follow each other
# Rule of the spoken passages (D5, plan-5-tasks.md): every passage starts exactly at its row's locator and is preceded by at least 30 s of digital
# silence (silence from second 0 when it starts under 30 s), so the reader's window starts at the first sound at or after the last lattice point and
# so at the sentence. The filler is counting, at 7 different loudnesses, so that the envelope of every 30 s block of a clip differs (K29).
